sources.note: Nothing. Ch. 4 'Anatomy of a Sign' (printed pp. 27-30, pp. 40-43) presents the five sign parameters (handshape, orientation, location, movement, non-manual markers); the only prosody-adjacent remark is that non-manual markers 'function similarly to intonation in spoken language' (printed p. 29 / p. 42). a full-text search for stress/accent/rhythm/suprasegmental finds no linguistic use.
